```json
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "GREEN",
          "default": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "BLUE",
          "default": 0
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "value",
      "returns": "Colour",
      "order": "ATOMIC",
      "code": "({RED}, {GREEN}, {BLUE})"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_np_set_pixel",
      "text": {
        "en": "set NeoPixel %1 to %2",
        "nl": "zet NeoPixel %1 op %2"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Set one pixel. The first pixel on the strip is 0.",
        "nl": "Zet een pixel. De eerste pixel op de strip is 0."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "INDEX",
          "default": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "value",
          "name": "COLOUR",
          "check": "Colour",
          "default": "colour('off')"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "strip.set_pixel({INDEX}, {COLOUR})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_np_fill",
      "text": {
        "en": "set whole NeoPixel strip to %1",
        "nl": "zet hele NeoPixel-strip op %1"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Set every pixel on the strip to the same colour.",
        "nl": "Zet elke pixel op de strip op dezelfde kleur."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "value",
          "name": "COLOUR",
          "check": "Colour",
          "default": "colour('off')"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "strip.fill({COLOUR})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_np_clear",
      "text": {
        "en": "switch NeoPixel strip off",
        "nl": "zet NeoPixel-strip uit"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Switch every pixel off at once.",
        "nl": "Zet elke pixel in een keer uit."
      },
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "strip.clear()\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_np_rainbow",
      "text": {
        "en": "rainbow across NeoPixel strip shifted by %1",
        "nl": "regenboog over NeoPixel-strip verschoven met %1"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Spread a rainbow along the strip. Increase the shift a little at a time to make it move.",
        "nl": "Spreid een regenboog over de strip. Verhoog de verschuiving stap voor stap om hem te laten bewegen."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "OFFSET",
          "default": 0
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "strip.rainbow({OFFSET})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_np_shift",
      "text": {
        "en": "shift NeoPixel strip by %1",
        "nl": "verschuif NeoPixel-strip met %1"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Move the whole pattern along the strip and wrap it around.",
        "nl": "Verplaats het hele patroon over de strip en laat het rondlopen."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "STEP",
          "default": 1
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "strip.shift({STEP})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_np_show",
      "text": {
        "en": "show NeoPixel changes",
        "nl": "toon NeoPixel-wijzigingen"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Send the colours to the strip. Only needed when updating is set to \"only when I say show\".",
        "nl": "Stuur de kleuren naar de strip. Alleen nodig bij \"alleen als ik toon zeg\"."
      },
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "strip.show()\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_np_auto_show",
      "text": {
        "en": "update NeoPixel strip %1",
        "nl": "werk NeoPixel-strip bij %1"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Choose whether every change appears at once, or waits for the show block.",
        "nl": "Kies of elke wijziging meteen verschijnt of wacht op het toon-blok."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "MODE",
          "options": [
            {
              "label": {
                "en": "straight away",
                "nl": "meteen"
              },
              "value": "True"
            },
            {
              "label": {
                "en": "only when I say show",
                "nl": "alleen als ik toon zeg"
              },
              "value": "False"
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "strip.set_auto_show({MODE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_np_count",
      "text": {
        "en": "number of NeoPixels",
        "nl": "aantal NeoPixels"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "How many pixels the strip was set up with.",
        "nl": "Hoeveel pixels de strip heeft."
      },
      "shape": "value",
      "returns": "Number",
      "order": "MEMBER",
      "code": "strip.count"
    }
  ],
```

```json
        "nl": "Zet tekst op een van de acht regels en vervang wat er stond. Er passen zestien tekens op een regel."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "value",
          "name": "MESSAGE",
          "default": "''"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "LINE",
          "options": "$lines"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.write_line({MESSAGE}, {LINE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_value",
      "text": {
        "en": "show %1 = %2 on OLED line %3",
        "nl": "toon %1 = %2 op OLED-regel %3"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Show a named reading, like \"distance: 24\". Whole numbers lose their decimal point and long decimals are rounded to two places.",
        "nl": "Toon een meting met naam, zoals \"afstand: 24\". Hele getallen verliezen de komma en lange decimalen worden op twee cijfers afgerond."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "value",
          "name": "LABEL",
          "default": "''"
        },
        {
          "type": "value",
          "name": "VALUE",
          "default": "0"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "LINE",
          "options": "$lines"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.write_value({LABEL}, {VALUE}, {LINE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_at",
      "text": {
        "en": "write %1 on OLED at x %2 y %3",
        "nl": "schrijf %1 op OLED bij x %2 y %3"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Put text anywhere by pixel. x runs 0 to 127 across, y runs 0 to 63 down. Nothing already on the screen is cleared.",
        "nl": "Zet tekst ergens neer per pixel. x loopt van 0 tot 127, y van 0 tot 63. Wat er al staat blijft staan."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "value",
          "name": "MESSAGE",
          "default": "''"
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "X",
          "default": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "Y",
          "default": 0
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.write_at({MESSAGE}, {X}, {Y})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_show",
      "text": {
        "en": "update the OLED now",
        "nl": "werk de OLED nu bij"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Send the picture to the screen. Only needed when updating is set to \"only when I say update\".",
        "nl": "Stuur de afbeelding naar het scherm. Alleen nodig bij \"alleen als ik bijwerk zeg\"."
      },
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.show()\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_auto_show",
      "text": {
        "en": "update OLED %1",
        "nl": "werk OLED bij %1"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Choose whether every change appears at once, or waits for the update block. Waiting is much faster when you write several lines in a row.",
        "nl": "Kies of elke wijziging meteen verschijnt of wacht op het bijwerk-blok. Wachten is veel sneller als je meerdere regels achter elkaar schrijft."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "MODE",
          "options": [
            {
              "label": {
                "en": "straight away",
                "nl": "meteen"
              },
              "value": "True"
            },
            {
              "label": {
                "en": "only when I say update",
                "nl": "alleen als ik bijwerk zeg"
              },
              "value": "False"
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.set_auto_show({MODE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_brightness",
      "text": {
        "en": "set OLED brightness to %1 %%",
        "nl": "stel OLED-helderheid in op %1 %%"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Brightness from 0 to 100 percent. The screen is easy to read well below 50, and a dim screen lasts longer.",
        "nl": "Helderheid van 0 tot 100 procent. Het scherm is ruim onder de 50 goed leesbaar, en een gedimd scherm gaat langer mee."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "PERCENT",
          "default": 50
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.set_brightness({PERCENT})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_invert",
      "text": {
        "en": "OLED colours %1",
        "nl": "OLED-kleuren %1"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Swap lit and unlit pixels. What you have written stays where it is.",
        "nl": "Wissel brandende en donkere pixels om. Wat je hebt geschreven blijft staan."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "MODE",
          "options": [
            {
              "label": {
                "en": "normal",
                "nl": "normaal"
              },
              "value": "NORMAL",
              "code": "False"
            },
            {
              "label": {
                "en": "inverted",
                "nl": "omgekeerd"
              },
              "value": "INVERTED",
              "code": "True"
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.invert({MODE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_power",
      "text": {
        "en": "switch the OLED screen %1",
        "nl": "zet het OLED-scherm %1"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Switch the panel off to save current. The picture is kept and comes back when you switch it on.",
        "nl": "Zet het scherm uit om stroom te sparen. De afbeelding blijft bewaard en komt terug als je het aanzet."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "STATE",
          "options": [
            {
              "label": {
                "en": "on",
                "nl": "aan"
              },
              "value": "ON",
              "code": "True"
            },
            {
              "label": {
                "en": "off",
                "nl": "uit"
              },
              "value": "OFF",
              "code": "False"
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.power({STATE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_arrow",
      "text": {
        "en": "show arrow on OLED pointing %1 degrees",
        "nl": "toon pijl op OLED die %1 graden wijst"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "0 is up, 90 is right, 180 is down, 270 is left. Plug the gyro heading block in and the arrow swings like a compass needle as the robot turns.",
        "nl": "0 is omhoog, 90 is rechts, 180 is omlaag, 270 is links. Sluit het gyro-kompasblok aan en de pijl draait mee als de robot draait."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "ANGLE",
          "default": 0
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.arrow({ANGLE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_big",
      "text": {
        "en": "show %1 big on OLED, size %2",
        "nl": "toon %1 groot op OLED, grootte %2"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "The normal font blown up and centred. A \"^\" becomes a chunky arrow, and a countdown digit can be read from across the room.",
        "nl": "Het gewone lettertype vergroot en gecentreerd. Een \"^\" wordt een dikke pijl, en een aftelcijfer is van ver te lezen."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "value",
          "name": "MESSAGE",
          "default": "''"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "SCALE",
          "options": "$sizes"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.big({MESSAGE}, {SCALE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_picture",
      "text": {
        "en": "show custom picture data %1 on OLED at x %2 y %3",
        "nl": "toon plaatje %1 op OLED bij x %2 y %3"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Draw a picture you sketched with the mouse. Open tools/oled-designer.html, draw, press Copy for XRP Blocks, and paste it into the text block here.",
        "nl": "Teken een plaatje dat je met de muis hebt gemaakt. Open tools/oled-designer.html, teken, druk op Copy for XRP Blocks en plak het in het tekstblok hier."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "value",
          "name": "DATA",
          "default": "''"
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "X",
          "default": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "Y",
          "default": 0
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.draw_picture({DATA}, {X}, {Y})\n",
      "helpUrl": "tools/oled-designer.html"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_pixel",
      "text": {
        "en": "set OLED pixel x %1 y %2 %3",
        "nl": "zet OLED-pixel x %1 y %2 %3"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "One dot. x runs 0 to 127 across, y runs 0 to 63 down.",
        "nl": "Een stip. x loopt van 0 tot 127, y van 0 tot 63."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "X",
          "default": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "Y",
          "default": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "STATE",
          "options": "$onoff"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.set_pixel({X}, {Y}, {STATE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_draw_line",
      "text": {
        "en": "OLED draw line from x %1 y %2 to x %3 y %4",
        "nl": "OLED teken lijn van x %1 y %2 naar x %3 y %4"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "A straight line between two points.",
        "nl": "Een rechte lijn tussen twee punten."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "X1",
          "default": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "Y1",
          "default": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "X2",
          "default": 127
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "Y2",
          "default": 63
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.line({X1}, {Y1}, {X2}, {Y2})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_rect",
      "text": {
        "en": "OLED draw %1 rectangle at x %2 y %3 width %4 height %5",
        "nl": "OLED teken %1 rechthoek bij x %2 y %3 breedte %4 hoogte %5"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "A rectangle, either just the outline or solid.",
        "nl": "Een rechthoek, alleen de omtrek of gevuld."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "FILL",
          "options": "$fills"
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "X",
          "default": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "Y",
          "default": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "W",
          "default": 40
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "H",
          "default": 20
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.rect({X}, {Y}, {W}, {H}, {FILL})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_circle",
      "text": {
        "en": "OLED draw %1 circle at x %2 y %3 radius %4",
        "nl": "OLED teken %1 cirkel bij x %2 y %3 straal %4"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "A circle, either just the outline or solid. x and y are the middle.",
        "nl": "Een cirkel, alleen de omtrek of gevuld. x en y zijn het midden."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "FILL",
          "options": "$fills"
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "X",
          "default": 64
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "Y",
          "default": 32
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "R",
          "default": 20
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.circle({X}, {Y}, {R}, {FILL})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_bar",
      "text": {
        "en": "OLED bar on line %1 showing %2 from %3 to %4",
        "nl": "OLED balk op regel %1 toont %2 van %3 tot %4"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "A bar across one text row that fills up as the reading rises. Good for a distance sensor or a battery level.",
        "nl": "Een balk over een tekstregel die voller wordt als de meting stijgt. Handig voor een afstandssensor of een accuniveau."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "LINE",
          "options": "$lines"
        },
        {
          "type": "value",
          "name": "VALUE",
          "default": "0"
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "MIN",
          "default": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "MAX",
          "default": 100
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.bar({VALUE}, {MIN}, {MAX}, {LINE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_connected",
      "text": {
        "en": "OLED is connected",
        "nl": "OLED is aangesloten"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "True if the screen answers right now. A program keeps running with the screen unplugged, so this is how it can tell.",
        "nl": "Waar als het scherm nu antwoordt. Een programma loopt door zonder scherm, dus zo kan het dat merken."
      },
      "shape": "value",
      "returns": "Boolean",
      "order": "FUNCTION_CALL",
      "code": "oled.is_connected()"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_width",
      "text": {
        "en": "OLED screen width",
        "nl": "OLED-schermbreedte"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "How many pixels across the screen is: 128.",
        "nl": "Hoeveel pixels het scherm breed is: 128."
      },
      "shape": "value",
      "returns": "Number",
      "order": "MEMBER",
      "code": "oled.width"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_height",
      "text": {
        "en": "OLED screen height",
        "nl": "OLED-schermhoogte"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "How many pixels down the screen is: 64.",
        "nl": "Hoeveel pixels het scherm hoog is: 64."
      },
      "shape": "value",
      "returns": "Number",
      "order": "MEMBER",
      "code": "oled.height"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_scroll_text",
      "text": {
        "en": "OLED scroll %1 on line %2 speed (pixels/sec) %3",
        "nl": "OLED schuif %1 op regel %2 snelheid (pixels/sec) %3"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Put inside a forever loop with a short wait. Long text scrolls left and repeats; short text stays still. Speed 1–120 pixels/sec. Does not pause your program. In manual update mode, also use OLED update.",
        "nl": "Plaats in een herhaallus met een korte wachttijd. Lange tekst schuift en herhaalt; korte tekst blijft staan. Snelheid 1–120 pixels/sec. Gebruik bij handmatig bijwerken ook OLED update."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "value",
          "name": "MESSAGE",
          "default": "''"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "LINE",
          "options": "$lines"
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "SPEED",
          "default": 30
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "oled.scroll_text({MESSAGE}, {LINE}, {SPEED})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_oled_icon",
      "text": {
        "en": "show OLED icon %1 size %2 at x %3 y %4",
```

```json
  "blocks": [
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_setup",
      "text": {
        "en": "set up triggers, check %1 times a second",
        "nl": "stel triggers in, controleer %1 keer per seconde"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Optional. Starts the trigger engine. 20 checks a second is plenty for lights; 2 to 50 allowed. Without this block the first trigger block starts it at 20.",
        "nl": "Optioneel. Start de triggers. 20 keer per seconde is genoeg voor lampjes; 2 tot 50 mag. Zonder dit blok start het eerste triggerblok ze op 20."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "RATE",
          "default": 20
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "configuresInstance": true,
      "code": ""
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_light_rule",
      "text": {
        "en": "while %1 show %2 %3 on the %4",
        "nl": "zolang %1 toon %2 %3 op de %4"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "A light rule. Runs in the background from now on. Movement is read from the two drive wheels, so it works with every Drive block. When two rules share a light: brake, then reversing, indicators, headlight, status. A light nobody has assigned uses the onboard RGB light.",
        "nl": "Een lichtregel. Werkt vanaf nu op de achtergrond. Beweging wordt van de twee aandrijfwielen gelezen, dus het werkt met elk rijblok. Delen twee regels een lamp: rem, dan achteruit, richtingaanwijzers, koplamp, status. Een lamp die niet is toegewezen gebruikt de RGB-led op het bord."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "EVENT",
          "options": "$events"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "COLOUR",
          "options": "$colours"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "PATTERN",
          "options": "$patterns"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "ROLE",
          "options": "$roles"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.light_rule({EVENT}, {COLOUR}, {PATTERN}, {ROLE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_servo_rule",
      "text": {
        "en": "while %1 move servo %2 to %3 degrees at %4 degrees/s, then back to %5 degrees",
        "nl": "zolang %1 zet servo %2 op %3 graden met %4 graden/s, daarna terug naar %5 graden"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "A servo rule. Speed 0 moves at once. When the rule ends the servo returns, then is left to the rest of your program. 5 to 175 degrees. A servo moving while the wheels drive causes a current spike.",
        "nl": "Een servoregel. Snelheid 0 beweegt meteen. Als de regel stopt gaat de servo terug en is daarna weer vrij voor de rest van je programma. 5 tot 175 graden. Een servo die beweegt terwijl de wielen rijden geeft een stroompiek."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "EVENT",
          "options": "$events"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "SERVO",
          "options": "$servos"
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "ANGLE",
          "default": 150
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "SPEED",
          "default": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "BACK",
          "default": 90
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.servo_rule({EVENT}, {SERVO}, {ANGLE}, {SPEED}, {BACK})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_estop_rule",
      "text": {
        "en": "emergency stop when %1",
        "nl": "noodstop wanneer %1"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Opt-in safety rule. When it happens, every motor brakes and motor commands are ignored until \"clear emergency stop\". Your program keeps running: a Drive block waits out its time limit with the wheels held. Check \"emergency stop is on\" to react.",
        "nl": "Veiligheidsregel. Als het gebeurt, remmen alle motoren en worden motoropdrachten genegeerd tot \"noodstop opheffen\". Je programma loopt door: een rijblok wacht zijn tijdslimiet af met de wielen vast. Gebruik \"noodstop is actief\" om te reageren."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "EVENT",
          "options": "$events"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.estop_rule({EVENT})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_estop_clear",
      "text": {
        "en": "clear emergency stop",
        "nl": "noodstop opheffen"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Lets the motors run again after an emergency stop.",
        "nl": "Laat de motoren weer draaien na een noodstop."
      },
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.clear_estop()\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_estop_active",
      "text": {
        "en": "emergency stop is on",
        "nl": "noodstop is actief"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "True after an emergency stop, until it is cleared.",
        "nl": "Waar na een noodstop, tot die is opgeheven."
      },
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "value",
      "returns": "Boolean",
      "order": "FUNCTION_CALL",
      "code": "triggers.estop_active()"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_happening",
      "text": {
        "en": "%1 is happening",
        "nl": "%1 gebeurt"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "True while this is happening, exactly as the rules see it (including the hold time).",
        "nl": "Waar zolang dit gebeurt, precies zoals de regels het zien (inclusief de vasthoudtijd)."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "EVENT",
          "options": "$events"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "value",
      "returns": "Boolean",
      "order": "FUNCTION_CALL",
      "code": "triggers.happening({EVENT})"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_define",
      "text": {
        "en": "define trigger %1 : %2 %3 %4",
        "nl": "stel trigger %1 in: %2 %3 %4"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Makes trigger A, B, C or D from a measurement. Speed, turning and distance come from the drive wheels; battery and line sensors are read by the engine itself.",
        "nl": "Maakt trigger A, B, C of D van een meting. Snelheid, draaien en afstand komen van de aandrijfwielen; batterij en lijnsensoren leest de engine zelf."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "SLOT",
          "options": "$slots"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "MEASURE",
          "options": "$measures"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "OP",
          "options": "$ops"
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "VALUE",
          "default": 20
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.define({SLOT}, {MEASURE}, {OP}, {VALUE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_define_pin",
      "text": {
        "en": "define trigger %1 : %2 is %3",
        "nl": "stel trigger %1 in: %2 is %3"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "A switch, bumper or button on a pin. Wire it between the pin and GND; the pin is pulled up inside, so pressed reads low.",
        "nl": "Een schakelaar, bumper of knop op een pin. Sluit hem aan tussen de pin en GND; de pin wordt intern omhoog getrokken, dus ingedrukt leest laag."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "SLOT",
          "options": "$slots"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "PIN",
          "options": "$pins"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "STATE",
          "options": "$pinstates"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.define_pin({SLOT}, {PIN}, {STATE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_define_value",
      "text": {
        "en": "define trigger %1 : value %2 %3 %4",
        "nl": "stel trigger %1 in: waarde %2 %3 %4"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "A trigger on a value your program posts with \"set trigger value\". Use it for the gyro, the distance sensor, a colour sensor or the remote control: those are read by your program, not by the engine.",
        "nl": "Een trigger op een waarde die je programma doorgeeft met \"zet triggerwaarde\". Gebruik dit voor de gyroscoop, de afstandssensor, een kleursensor of de afstandsbediening: die leest je programma, niet de engine."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "SLOT",
          "options": "$slots"
        },
        {
          "type": "text",
          "name": "NAME",
          "default": "'tilt'"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "OP",
          "options": "$ops"
        },
        {
          "type": "value",
          "name": "VALUE",
          "default": "0"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.define_value({SLOT}, {NAME}, {OP}, {VALUE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_define_every",
      "text": {
        "en": "define trigger %1 : every %2 seconds",
        "nl": "stel trigger %1 in: elke %2 seconden"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Happens once every so many seconds. The hold time keeps a light on long enough to see.",
        "nl": "Gebeurt eens per zoveel seconden. De vasthoudtijd houdt een lamp lang genoeg aan om te zien."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "SLOT",
          "options": "$slots"
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "SECONDS",
          "default": 2
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.define_every({SLOT}, {SECONDS})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_set_value",
      "text": {
        "en": "set trigger value %1 to %2",
        "nl": "zet triggerwaarde %1 op %2"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Posts a value for \"define trigger ... value\" to test. Put it in your loop, after reading the sensor.",
        "nl": "Geeft een waarde door voor \"stel trigger in ... waarde\". Zet het in je lus, na het lezen van de sensor."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "text",
          "name": "NAME",
          "default": "'tilt'"
        },
        {
          "type": "value",
          "name": "VALUE",
          "default": "0"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.set_value({NAME}, {VALUE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_measure",
      "text": {
        "en": "trigger measurement %1",
        "nl": "triggermeting %1"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "The value the engine sees right now. Print it to choose thresholds for your robot.",
        "nl": "De waarde die de engine nu ziet. Print hem om drempels voor je robot te kiezen."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "MEASURE",
          "options": "$measures"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "value",
      "returns": "Number",
      "order": "FUNCTION_CALL",
      "code": "triggers.measure({MEASURE})"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_reset_distance",
      "text": {
        "en": "reset trigger distance",
        "nl": "triggerafstand op nul"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Sets \"distance travelled\" back to 0.",
        "nl": "Zet \"afgelegde afstand\" terug op 0."
      },
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.reset_distance()\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_use_rgb",
      "text": {
        "en": "use the onboard RGB light as the %1",
        "nl": "gebruik de RGB-led op het bord als %1"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Assigns a light. Without any assignment every light uses the onboard RGB light. Do not also use the Board RGB blocks: they would fight over the light.",
        "nl": "Wijst een lamp toe. Zonder toewijzing gebruikt elke lamp de RGB-led op het bord. Gebruik dan niet ook de RGB-blokken van Bord: die vechten om dezelfde led."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "ROLE",
          "options": "$roles"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.use_rgb({ROLE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_use_board_led",
      "text": {
        "en": "use the board LED as the %1",
        "nl": "gebruik de led op het bord als %1"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "The small single-colour LED. Any colour lights it; pulsing shows as blinking.",
        "nl": "De kleine eenkleurige led. Elke kleur zet hem aan; pulserend wordt knipperen."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "ROLE",
          "options": "$roles"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.use_board_led({ROLE})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_use_pin",
      "text": {
        "en": "use the LED on %1 as the %2",
        "nl": "gebruik de led op %1 als %2"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "A plain LED with a resistor (about 220 ohm) between the pin and GND. Any colour lights it.",
        "nl": "Een gewone led met weerstand (ongeveer 220 ohm) tussen de pin en GND. Elke kleur zet hem aan."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "PIN",
          "options": "$pins"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "ROLE",
          "options": "$roles"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.use_pin({ROLE}, {PIN})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_strip",
      "text": {
        "en": "trigger LED strip on %1 with %2 pixels",
        "nl": "trigger-ledstrip op %1 met %2 pixels"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "A NeoPixel strip for the trigger lights only (up to 30 pixels; longer strips take too long to write). Do not use the NeoPixel library on the same pin.",
        "nl": "Een NeoPixel-strip alleen voor de triggerlampen (tot 30 pixels; langere strips kosten te veel tijd). Gebruik de NeoPixel-bibliotheek niet op dezelfde pin."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "PIN",
          "options": "$pins"
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "COUNT",
          "default": 8
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.strip({PIN}, {COUNT})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_use_pixels",
      "text": {
        "en": "use strip pixels %1 to %2 as the %3",
        "nl": "gebruik strippixels %1 tot %2 als %3"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Pixels count from 0. For example 0 to 1 as the left indicator and 6 to 7 as the right one.",
        "nl": "Pixels tellen vanaf 0. Bijvoorbeeld 0 tot 1 als richtingaanwijzer links en 6 tot 7 als rechts."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "FIRST",
          "default": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "LAST",
          "default": 1
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "ROLE",
          "options": "$roles"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.use_pixels({ROLE}, {FIRST}, {LAST})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_set_light",
      "text": {
        "en": "set the %1 to %2 %3",
        "nl": "zet de %1 op %2 %3"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Sets a light by hand. A rule for the same light takes priority while it is happening. Choose off to clear it.",
        "nl": "Zet een lamp met de hand. Een regel voor dezelfde lamp gaat voor zolang die gebeurt. Kies uit om te wissen."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "ROLE",
          "options": "$roles"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "COLOUR",
          "options": "$colours"
        },
        {
          "type": "dropdown",
          "name": "PATTERN",
          "options": "$patterns"
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.set_light({ROLE}, {COLOUR}, {PATTERN})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_all_off",
      "text": {
        "en": "all trigger lights off",
        "nl": "alle triggerlampen uit"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "Clears every light set by hand. Rules keep working.",
        "nl": "Wist alle met de hand gezette lampen. Regels blijven werken."
      },
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.all_off()\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_brightness",
      "text": {
        "en": "trigger lights brightness %1 %%",
        "nl": "helderheid triggerlampen %1 %%"
      },
      "tooltip": {
        "en": "0 to 100%. Default 30%. Keep it low with a strip: bright pixels draw a lot of current.",
        "nl": "0 tot 100%. Standaard 30%. Houd het laag bij een strip: felle pixels gebruiken veel stroom."
      },
      "args": [
        {
          "type": "number",
          "name": "PERCENT",
          "default": 30
        }
      ],
      "inline": true,
      "shape": "statement",
      "code": "triggers.set_brightness({PERCENT})\n"
    },
    {
      "type": "xrp_trig_hold",
      "text": {
        "en": "keep trigger actions on for at least %1 seconds",
        "nl": "houd triggeracties minstens %1 seconden aan"
      },
      "tooltip": {
```

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#10151e">
<title>XRP phone control</title>
<!--
  XRP phone control over Bluetooth (XRP Blocks, Phone control library 1.1.1).
  Talks to the robot's own Bluetooth link (Nordic UART Service, the same one an
  IDE uses) with Web Bluetooth. Needs Chrome on Android and an https:// address.
  Protocol: see lib/BLERemote.py. Only ASCII digits, letters and spaces are ever
  sent, never Ctrl+C or the IDE's stop string, so it cannot interrupt the robot.
-->
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--bg:#10151e;--panel:#182231;--btn:#202d40;--line:#354459;--text:#edf4ff;--muted:#a9b7cd;--live:#79e2b1;--warn:#ffcf70;--held:#2d6596;--heldline:#9dcfff;--a:#284736;--b:#443156;--danger:#542633}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
body{padding:16px;padding-bottom:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
main{max-width:680px;margin:auto}
header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}
h1{font-size:24px;margin:4px 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
button,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--btn);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 16px;cursor:pointer}
button:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #83b7ff;outline-offset:3px}
#connect{flex:none;background:#2d6596;border-color:var(--heldline);font-weight:600}
#status{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);min-height:1.4em;margin:6px 0}
#status.live{color:var(--live)}#status.warn{color:var(--warn)}
#message{min-height:1.4em;margin:4px 0 10px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;display:none}
#message.show{display:block}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:8px 0}
select{padding:10px;background:var(--btn);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px}
.pad{touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;min-height:88px;font-size:18px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.pad small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin-top:6px}
.pad .sym{font-size:24px;line-height:1;margin-bottom:4px}
.pad.held{background:var(--held);border-color:var(--heldline)}
.pad:disabled,.stick.off{opacity:.45}
#controls{margin:12px 0}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.dpad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.dpad .p1{grid-area:1/2}.dpad .p2{grid-area:2/1}.dpad .p3{grid-area:2/3}.dpad .p4{grid-area:3/2}.dpad .p5{grid-area:4/1;background:var(--a)}.dpad .p6{grid-area:4/3;background:var(--b)}
.dpad .p5.held,.dpad .p6.held,.joy .p5.held,.joy .p6.held{background:var(--held)}
.joy{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;align-items:center}
.joy .side{display:grid;gap:12px}
.joy .p5{background:var(--a);min-height:110px}.joy .p6{background:var(--b);min-height:110px}
.joy .small{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;grid-column:1/-1}
.joy .small .pad{min-height:64px;font-size:14px;padding:8px 4px;overflow-wrap:normal;word-break:keep-all}.joy .small .pad .name{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:100%}.joy .small .pad small{display:none}
.stick{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:300px;aspect-ratio:1;margin:auto;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#223249 0 58%,#1a2638 59%);border:2px solid var(--line);touch-action:none;user-select:none}
.stick::before,.stick::after{content:"";position:absolute;background:#2f3e55;left:50%;top:8%;bottom:8%;width:2px;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.stick::after{top:50%;left:8%;right:8%;bottom:auto;height:2px;width:auto;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.knob{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:34%;height:34%;margin:-17% 0 0 -17%;border-radius:50%;background:#3d7ec0;border:2px solid var(--heldline);box-shadow:0 4px 14px #0008;z-index:1;transition:transform .08s}
.stick.active .knob{transition:none}
#readout{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin-top:6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#release{width:100%;background:var(--danger);border-color:#a74660;margin-top:14px}
details{margin-top:20px;color:var(--muted)}summary{cursor:pointer;padding:6px 0}
details p,details li{line-height:1.5}
footer{font-size:12px;color:#8293ac;margin-top:18px;line-height:1.5}
.hidden{display:none!important}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:520px){body{padding:8px 16px}h1{font-size:19px}#status{margin:2px 0}#message{margin:2px 0 4px;padding:4px 10px}.row{margin:4px 0}select{padding:6px}#controls{margin:6px 0}.stick{max-width:44vh}.pad{min-height:54px}.pad small{display:none}.joy .p5,.joy .p6{min-height:64px}.joy .small .pad{min-height:48px}}
@media (max-width:360px){.pad{font-size:15px}}
.check{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer}
.check input{width:22px;height:22px;accent-color:#3d7ec0}
#readings{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:8px;margin:8px 0}
.tile{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:6px 10px;min-width:0}
.tile .n{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.tile .v{font-size:22px;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.tile.fresh .v{color:var(--live)}
#feedlog{margin-top:14px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px}
#feedlog header{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
#feedlog button{padding:4px 10px;font-size:13px;border-radius:8px}
#log{list-style:none;margin:6px 0 0;padding:0;max-height:180px;overflow-y:auto;font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:14px}
#log li{padding:3px 0;border-top:1px solid #243248;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#log li:first-child{border-top:0}
#log .t{color:var(--muted);margin-right:8px}
.empty{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
/* Messages view: readings as one large block, no controls */
body.msgmode #release{display:none}
body.msgmode #readings{display:block;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:4px 14px;margin:12px 0}
body.msgmode #readings.hidden{display:block!important}
body.msgmode .tile{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;background:none;border:0;border-top:1px solid #243248;border-radius:0;padding:12px 0}
body.msgmode .tile:first-child{border-top:0}
body.msgmode .tile .n{font-size:17px;color:var(--text);white-space:normal}
body.msgmode .tile .v{font-size:30px;text-align:right}
body.msgmode #feedlog{margin-top:0}
#readings .waiting{color:var(--muted);padding:14px 0;font-size:15px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main>
  <header>
    <h1 id="title">XRP phone control</h1>
    <button id="connect">Connect</button>
  </header>
  <div id="status" role="status" aria-live="polite">Not connected.</div>
  <div id="message" aria-live="polite"></div>

  <div class="row">
    <label for="layout">Layout</label>
    <select id="layout">
      <option value="joy">Joystick</option>
      <option value="dpad">Game D-pad</option>
      <option value="grid">Button grid</option>
      <option value="msg">Messages</option>
    </select>
    <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="feed"> Show robot messages</label>
  </div>
  <div id="readings" class="hidden" aria-label="Readings from the robot" aria-live="off"></div>

  <section id="controls" aria-label="Controls"></section>
  <button id="release">Release everything</button>
  <section id="feedlog" class="hidden" aria-label="Messages from the robot">
    <header class="row" style="justify-content:space-between;margin:0"><span>Messages from the robot</span><button id="clearlog" type="button">Clear</button></header>
    <ul id="log"></ul>
  </section>

  <details>
    <summary>How to use</summary>
    <ol>
      <li>Close any IDE that is connected to the robot over Bluetooth (USB is fine).</li>
      <li>Start a program that uses <b>phone control over Bluetooth: start</b>: switch the robot on with it saved as main.py, or click Run over USB.</li>
      <li>Tap <b>Connect</b> and choose the robot (its name starts with XRP-).</li>
    </ol>
    <p>Joystick: up is forward (+), right is right (+), both -100 to 100. D-pad: Up = 1, Left = 2, Right = 3, Down = 4, A = 5, B = 6. Your program decides what each input does.</p>
    <p>Messages view: no controls, just a large block with every reading from the robot ("phone show value") and the message log ("phone print"). It shows them whether or not the tick box is ticked.</p>
    <p>If you switch apps, lock the phone or lose the link, every input is released and the robot sees "not connected" within a second. The program must stop the motors itself.</p>
  </details>
  <footer id="support"></footer>
</main>

<script>
(() => {
'use strict';
const NUS = '6e400001-b5a3-f393-e0a9-e50e24dcca9e';
const TX = '6e400002-b5a3-f393-e0a9-e50e24dcca9e';   // phone -> robot (write)
const RX = '6e400003-b5a3-f393-e0a9-e50e24dcca9e';   // robot -> phone (indicate)
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const enc = new TextEncoder(), dec = new TextDecoder();

let device = null, txChar = null, rxChar = null;
let linked = false;          // GATT connected
let lastOk = 0;              // last "#xrp ok" from a listening program
let lastHello = 0, lastSent = 0, sentKey = '', writing = false, pendingKey = null;
let rxLine = '', replSeen = false, lastRx = 0;
let feedWanted = false, feedSent = null, lastFeedSent = 0, currentLayout = 'joy';
// Robot messages are on when the box is ticked, or always in the Messages view.
function feedOn() { return feedWanted || currentLayout === 'msg'; }
const tiles = new Map();
let labels = ['Up', 'Left', 'Right', 'Down', 'A', 'B'];
const held = new Map();      // pointerId -> button index
const keysHeld = new Set();
let stick = {x: 0, y: 0};
const pads = [];

// ---------- storage (per-viewer convenience only) ----------
function load(k, d) { try { const v = localStorage.getItem(k); return v === null ? d : v; } catch { return d; } }
function save(k, v) { try { localStorage.setItem(k, v); } catch {} }

// ---------- status ----------
function status(text, cls) { const s = $('status'); s.textContent = text; s.className = cls || ''; }
function listening() { return linked && Date.now() - lastOk < 1500; }

// ---------- build controls ----------
const SYM = ['▲', '◀', '▶', '▼', 'A', 'B'];
function makePad(i, extraClass) {
  const b = document.createElement('button');
  b.className = 'pad p' + (i + 1) + (extraClass ? ' ' + extraClass : '');
  b.type = 'button';
  const sym = document.createElement('span'); sym.className = 'sym'; sym.textContent = SYM[i]; sym.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  const name = document.createElement('span'); name.className = 'name';
  const hint = document.createElement('small'); hint.textContent = 'button ' + (i + 1);
  b.append(sym, name, hint);
  b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
  b.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { e.preventDefault(); b.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); held.set(e.pointerId, i); changed(); });
  const up = e => { if (held.delete(e.pointerId)) changed(); };
  b.addEventListener('pointerup', up); b.addEventListener('pointercancel', up); b.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', up);
  b.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if ((e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') && !e.repeat) { e.preventDefault(); keysHeld.add(i); changed(); } });
  b.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); keysHeld.delete(i); changed(); } });
  b.addEventListener('blur', () => { if (keysHeld.delete(i)) changed(); });
  b.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault());
  pads.push({i, el: b});
  return b;
}

function makeStick() {
  const s = document.createElement('div');
  s.className = 'stick'; s.setAttribute('role', 'application');
  s.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Joystick. Drag, or use the arrow keys.'); s.tabIndex = 0;
  const knob = document.createElement('div'); knob.className = 'knob'; s.append(knob);
  let pid = null;
  const setFrom = e => {
    const r = s.getBoundingClientRect();
    let dx = (e.clientX - r.left - r.width / 2) / (r.width * 0.36);
    let dy = (e.clientY - r.top - r.height / 2) / (r.height * 0.36);
    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy); if (len > 1) { dx /= len; dy /= len; }
    setStick(dx, -dy);
  };
  s.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { e.preventDefault(); pid = e.pointerId; s.setPointerCapture(pid); s.classList.add('active'); setFrom(e); });
  s.addEventListener('pointermove', e => { if (e.pointerId === pid) setFrom(e); });
  const end = e => { if (e.pointerId !== pid) return; pid = null; s.classList.remove('active'); setStick(0, 0); };
  s.addEventListener('pointerup', end); s.addEventListener('pointercancel', end); s.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', end);
  const arrows = {ArrowUp: [0, 1], ArrowDown: [0, -1], ArrowLeft: [-1, 0], ArrowRight: [1, 0]};
  const down = new Set();
  const fromKeys = () => { let x = 0, y = 0; down.forEach(k => { x += arrows[k][0]; y += arrows[k][1]; }); const l = Math.hypot(x, y) || 1; setStick(x / l, y / l); };
  s.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (arrows[e.key]) { e.preventDefault(); down.add(e.key); fromKeys(); } });
  s.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (arrows[e.key]) { e.preventDefault(); down.delete(e.key); fromKeys(); } });
  s.addEventListener('blur', () => { down.clear(); setStick(0, 0); });
  s.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault());
  s._knob = knob;
  return s;
}

function setStick(fx, fy) {
  // Dead zone of 8 so a resting thumb reads 0.
  let x = Math.round(fx * 100), y = Math.round(fy * 100);
  if (Math.hypot(x, y) < 8) { x = 0; y = 0; }
  stick = {x, y};
  const s = document.querySelector('.stick');
  if (s) s._knob.style.transform = `translate(${fx * 106}%, ${-fy * 106}%)`;
  changed();
}

function build(layout) {
  releaseAll(false);
  pads.length = 0;
  const wasOn = feedOn();
  currentLayout = layout;
  document.body.classList.toggle('msgmode', layout === 'msg');
  if (wasOn && !feedOn()) { tiles.clear(); $('readings').textContent = ''; }
  const c = $('controls'); c.textContent = '';
  if (layout === 'msg') {
    // No controls: the readings block and the log fill the page.
  } else if (layout === 'joy') {
    const wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.className = 'joy';
    const left = document.createElement('div');
    left.append(makeStick());
    const ro = document.createElement('div'); ro.id = 'readout'; left.append(ro);
    const side = document.createElement('div'); side.className = 'side';
    side.append(makePad(4), makePad(5));
    const small = document.createElement('div'); small.className = 'small';
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) small.append(makePad(i));
    wrap.append(left, side, small);
    c.append(wrap);
  } else {
    const wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.className = layout === 'dpad' ? 'dpad' : 'grid';
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) wrap.append(makePad(i));
    c.append(wrap);
  }
  paint(); paintFeed(); tick(true);
}

function paint() {
  const on = listening();
  const mask = currentMask();
  pads.forEach(({i, el}) => {
    el.querySelector('.name').textContent = labels[i] || ('Button ' + (i + 1));
    const h = !!(mask & (1 << i));
    el.classList.toggle('held', h); el.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(h));
  });
  const s = document.querySelector('.stick'); if (s) s.classList.toggle('off', !on);
  const ro = $('readout'); if (ro) ro.textContent = `forward ${stick.y}   right ${stick.x}`;
}

// ---------- state ----------
function currentMask() {
  let m = 0;
  held.forEach(i => { m |= 1 << i; });
  keysHeld.forEach(i => { m |= 1 << i; });
  return m;
}
function stateKey() { return `${currentMask()} ${stick.x} ${stick.y}`; }
function changed() { paint(); tick(true); }

function releaseAll(send = true) {
  held.clear(); keysHeld.clear(); stick = {x: 0, y: 0};
  const s = document.querySelector('.stick'); if (s) s._knob.style.transform = '';
  paint(); if (send) tick(true);
}

// ---------- Bluetooth ----------
async function write(text) {
  if (!txChar) return;
  // Robot side (ble_uart_peripheral) only accepts write-with-response.
  const data = enc.encode(text);
  if (txChar.writeValueWithResponse) await txChar.writeValueWithResponse(data);
  else await txChar.writeValue(data);
}

async function tick(force) {
  if (!linked || writing) { if (force && linked) pendingKey = 'x'; return; }
  const now = Date.now();
  let line = null;
  if (!listening()) {
    // Say hello until a program answers. Slower once we know only the
    // REPL is there, so its screen is not flooded with echoes.
    const gap = replSeen ? 2000 : 1000;
    if (now - lastHello >= gap) { lastHello = now; line = '#xrp h\r\n'; }
  } else {
    const key = stateKey();
    if (key !== sentKey || now - lastSent >= 250 || (force && key !== sentKey)) {
      line = `#xrp s ${key}\r\n`; sentKey = key; lastSent = now;
    } else if (feedSent !== feedOn() || now - lastFeedSent >= 3000) {
      // Tell the program whether to send readings and log lines; repeated
      // every 3 s in case it restarted.
      line = `#xrp o ${feedOn() ? 1 : 0}\r\n`; feedSent = feedOn(); lastFeedSent = now;
    }
  }
  if (!line) return;
  writing = true;
  try { await write(line); }
  catch (e) { /* a failed write is followed by a disconnect event or the next tick */ }
  finally {
    writing = false;
    if (pendingKey) { pendingKey = null; setTimeout(() => tick(true), 0); }
  }
}

function onLine(line) {
  line = line.replace(/\r$/, '');
  if (line.startsWith('#xrp ok')) {
    if (!listening()) { status('Connected: program listening.', 'live'); }
    lastOk = Date.now(); replSeen = false; paint();
  } else if (line.startsWith('#xrp cfg ')) {
    const parts = line.slice(9).split('|');
    if (parts[0]) { $('title').textContent = parts[0]; document.title = parts[0]; }
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) if (parts[i + 1] !== undefined) labels[i] = parts[i + 1].trim() || ('Button ' + (i + 1));
    paint();
  } else if (line.startsWith('#xrp v ')) {
    if (!feedOn()) return;
    const body = line.slice(7), bar = body.indexOf('|');
    if (bar < 1) return;
    showReading(body.slice(0, bar), body.slice(bar + 1));
  } else if (line.startsWith('#xrp p ')) {
    if (feedOn()) addLog(line.slice(7));
  } else if (line.startsWith('#xrp m ')) {
    const m = $('message'); m.textContent = line.slice(7); m.classList.add('show');
  }
}

function onNotify(e) {
  const v = e.target.value;
  const text = dec.decode(new Uint8Array(v.buffer, v.byteOffset, v.byteLength), {stream: true});
  lastRx = Date.now();
  if (text.includes('>>>')) replSeen = true;
  rxLine += text;
  let n;
  while ((n = rxLine.indexOf('\n')) !== -1) { onLine(rxLine.slice(0, n)); rxLine = rxLine.slice(n + 1); }
  if (rxLine.length > 400) rxLine = '';
}

// ---------- robot messages (opt-in) ----------
function showReading(name, value) {
  let t = tiles.get(name);
  if (!t) {
    t = document.createElement('div'); t.className = 'tile';
    const n = document.createElement('div'); n.className = 'n'; n.textContent = name;
    const v = document.createElement('div'); v.className = 'v';
    t.append(n, v); t._v = v;
    tiles.set(name, t); $('readings').append(t);
  }
  if (t._v.textContent !== value) {
    t._v.textContent = value;
    t.classList.add('fresh'); clearTimeout(t._timer);
    t._timer = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('fresh'), 600);
  }
  paintFeed();
}
function addLog(text) {
  const li = document.createElement('li');
  const time = document.createElement('span'); time.className = 't';
  time.textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit'});
  li.append(time, document.createTextNode(text));
  const log = $('log'); log.append(li);
  while (log.children.length > 20) log.firstChild.remove();
  log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
  paintFeed();
}
function paintFeed() {
  const on = feedOn(), r = $('readings');
  r.classList.toggle('hidden', !on || tiles.size === 0);
  $('feedlog').classList.toggle('hidden', !on);
  const wait = r.querySelector('.waiting');
  if (currentLayout === 'msg' && tiles.size === 0) {
    if (!wait) {
      const w = document.createElement('div'); w.className = 'waiting';
      w.textContent = 'Waiting for readings. Use "phone show value" blocks in your program.';
      r.append(w);
    }
  } else if (wait) wait.remove();
  const log = $('log');
  if (on && !log.querySelector('li')) {
    if (!log.querySelector('.empty')) {
      const e = document.createElement('li'); e.className = 'empty';
      e.textContent = 'Nothing yet. Use the "phone show value" and "phone print" blocks in your program.';
      log.append(e);
    }
  } else if (log.querySelector('li:not(.empty)')) {
    const e = log.querySelector('.empty'); if (e) e.remove();
  }
}
function setFeed(on) {
  feedWanted = on; save('xrp-phone-feed', on ? '1' : '0');
  if (!feedOn()) { tiles.clear(); $('readings').textContent = ''; }
  paintFeed(); tick(true);
}

function onDisconnect() {
  linked = false; txChar = rxChar = null; lastOk = 0; feedSent = null;
  releaseAll(false);
  status('Disconnected. Tap Reconnect.', 'warn');
  $('connect').textContent = 'Reconnect';
}

async function connect() {
  if (!('bluetooth' in navigator)) { unsupported(); return; }
  $('connect').disabled = true;
  try {
    if (!device || !device.gatt) {
      status('Choose your robot (XRP-…) in the list.');
      device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({filters: [{namePrefix: 'XRP'}], optionalServices: [NUS]});
      device.addEventListener('gattserverdisconnected', onDisconnect);
    }
    status('Connecting to ' + (device.name || 'robot') + '…');
    const server = await device.gatt.connect();
    const svc = await server.getPrimaryService(NUS);
    txChar = await svc.getCharacteristic(TX);
    rxChar = await svc.getCharacteristic(RX);
    await rxChar.startNotifications();
    rxChar.addEventListener('characteristicvaluechanged', onNotify);
    linked = true; lastHello = 0; replSeen = false; rxLine = '';
    status('Connected to ' + (device.name || 'robot') + '. Waiting for a program…', 'warn');
    $('connect').textContent = 'Disconnect';
    tick(true);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e && e.name === 'NotFoundError') status('No robot chosen.');
    else status('Could not connect: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e) + '. Is an IDE still connected over Bluetooth?', 'warn');
    $('connect').textContent = device ? 'Reconnect' : 'Connect';
  } finally { $('connect').disabled = false; }
}

async function toggle() {
  if (linked && device) {
    releaseAll(false);
    try { await write(`#xrp s 0 0 0\r\n`); } catch {}
    device.gatt.disconnect();
    device = null; $('connect').textContent = 'Connect'; status('Not connected.');
  } else connect();
}

function unsupported() {
  const secure = window.isSecureContext;
  status(secure ? 'This browser cannot use Bluetooth. Use Chrome on an Android phone.'
                : 'Bluetooth needs a secure page. Open this page from an https:// address.', 'warn');
  $('support').textContent = 'Web Bluetooth works in Chrome on Android (and Chrome or Edge on a laptop). iPhone Safari does not support it.';
}

// ---------- wiring ----------
$('connect').addEventListener('click', toggle);
$('release').addEventListener('click', () => releaseAll(true));
$('feed').addEventListener('change', () => setFeed($('feed').checked));
$('clearlog').addEventListener('click', () => { $('log').textContent = ''; paintFeed(); });
$('layout').addEventListener('change', () => { save('xrp-phone-layout', $('layout').value); build($('layout').value); });
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden) releaseAll(true); });
window.addEventListener('blur', () => releaseAll(true));
window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { releaseAll(false); if (linked) { write('#xrp s 0 0 0\r\n').catch(() => {}); } });

setInterval(() => {
  if (linked && lastOk && !listening()) {
    lastOk = 0; feedSent = null; releaseAll(false);
    status(replSeen ? 'Connected, but no program is listening. Start a program that uses phone control.'
                    : 'Connected. Waiting for a program…', 'warn');
  } else if (linked && !lastOk && replSeen) {
    status('Connected, but no program is listening. Start a program that uses phone control.', 'warn');
  }
  tick(false);
}, 100);

let layout = load('xrp-phone-layout', 'joy');
if (!['joy', 'dpad', 'grid', 'msg'].includes(layout)) layout = 'joy';
feedWanted = load('xrp-phone-feed', '0') === '1';
$('layout').value = layout;
build(layout);
$('feed').checked = feedWanted; paintFeed();
if (!('bluetooth' in navigator)) unsupported();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
  <script>
    'use strict';

    // ── The picture ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Kept as one byte per pixel while editing, because that is far easier to
    // reason about. It is packed into the screen's own MONO_VLSB layout only
    // when the block text is produced.

    const state = {
      width: 128,
      height: 64,
      pixels: null,
      tool: 'pencil',
      zoom: 8,
      grid: true,
      drawing: false,
      erasing: false,
      start: null,
      undo: [],
      redo: [],
    };

    const editor = document.getElementById('editor');
    const context = editor.getContext('2d');
    const preview1 = document.getElementById('preview1');
    const preview2 = document.getElementById('preview2');
    const output = document.getElementById('output');
    const status = document.getElementById('status');
    const loadStatus = document.getElementById('load-status');

    function blank(width, height) {
      return new Uint8Array(width * height);
    }

    function resize(width, height) {
      state.width = width;
      state.height = height;
      state.pixels = blank(width, height);
      state.undo = [];
      state.redo = [];
      updateHistoryButtons();
      layout();
      redraw();
    }

    function layout() {
      editor.width = state.width * state.zoom;
      editor.height = state.height * state.zoom;
      preview1.width = state.width;
      preview1.height = state.height;
      preview2.width = state.width * 2;
      preview2.height = state.height * 2;
    }

    // ── Drawing on screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

    function redraw(overlay) {
      const { width, height, zoom } = state;
      const shown = overlay || state.pixels;

      context.fillStyle = '#000';
      context.fillRect(0, 0, editor.width, editor.height);

      context.fillStyle = '#DFF6F3';
      for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
          if (shown[y * width + x]) {
            context.fillRect(x * zoom, y * zoom, zoom, zoom);
          }
        }
      }

      if (state.grid && zoom >= 4) {
        context.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120, 132, 160, 0.28)';
        context.lineWidth = 1;
        context.beginPath();
        for (let x = 0; x <= width; x++) {
          context.moveTo(x * zoom + 0.5, 0);
          context.lineTo(x * zoom + 0.5, height * zoom);
        }
        for (let y = 0; y <= height; y++) {
          context.moveTo(0, y * zoom + 0.5);
          context.lineTo(width * zoom, y * zoom + 0.5);
        }
        context.stroke();

        // Every eighth row is a page boundary on the real screen, and every
        // eighth column is one character of the font.
        context.strokeStyle = 'rgba(77, 182, 172, 0.45)';
        context.beginPath();
        for (let x = 0; x <= width; x += 8) {
          context.moveTo(x * zoom + 0.5, 0);
          context.lineTo(x * zoom + 0.5, height * zoom);
        }
        for (let y = 0; y <= height; y += 8) {
          context.moveTo(0, y * zoom + 0.5);
          context.lineTo(width * zoom, y * zoom + 0.5);
        }
        context.stroke();
      }

      drawPreview(preview1, shown, 1);
      drawPreview(preview2, shown, 2);
      output.value = encode(state.pixels, state.width, state.height);
    }

    function drawPreview(canvas, pixels, scale) {
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#DFF6F3';
      for (let y = 0; y < state.height; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < state.width; x++) {
          if (pixels[y * state.width + x]) {
            ctx.fillRect(x * scale, y * scale, scale, scale);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // ── Pixel operations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

    function setPixel(target, x, y, value) {
      if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= state.width || y >= state.height) return;
      target[y * state.width + x] = value;
    }

    function drawLine(target, x1, y1, x2, y2, value) {
      // Bresenham, the same shape framebuf draws on the robot.
      let dx = Math.abs(x2 - x1);
      let dy = -Math.abs(y2 - y1);
      const sx = x1 < x2 ? 1 : -1;
      const sy = y1 < y2 ? 1 : -1;
      let error = dx + dy;
      for (;;) {
        setPixel(target, x1, y1, value);
        if (x1 === x2 && y1 === y2) break;
        const e2 = 2 * error;
        if (e2 >= dy) { error += dy; x1 += sx; }
        if (e2 <= dx) { error += dx; y1 += sy; }
      }
    }

    function drawRect(target, x1, y1, x2, y2, value, filled) {
      const left = Math.min(x1, x2);
      const right = Math.max(x1, x2);
      const top = Math.min(y1, y2);
      const bottom = Math.max(y1, y2);
      if (filled) {
        for (let y = top; y <= bottom; y++) {
          for (let x = left; x <= right; x++) setPixel(target, x, y, value);
        }
      } else {
        drawLine(target, left, top, right, top, value);
        drawLine(target, left, bottom, right, bottom, value);
        drawLine(target, left, top, left, bottom, value);
        drawLine(target, right, top, right, bottom, value);
      }
    }

    function drawCircle(target, cx, cy, radius, value, filled) {
      // Midpoint circle, matching the driver's circle() on the robot.
      let x = radius;
      let y = 0;
      let error = 1 - radius;
      if (radius < 0) return;
      while (x >= y) {
        if (filled) {
          for (let i = cx - x; i <= cx + x; i++) {
            setPixel(target, i, cy + y, value);
            setPixel(target, i, cy - y, value);
          }
          for (let i = cx - y; i <= cx + y; i++) {
            setPixel(target, i, cy + x, value);
            setPixel(target, i, cy - x, value);
          }
        } else {
          [[x, y], [y, x], [-x, y], [-y, x], [-x, -y], [-y, -x], [x, -y], [y, -x]]
            .forEach(([ox, oy]) => setPixel(target, cx + ox, cy + oy, value));
        }
        y++;
        if (error < 0) {
          error += 2 * y + 1;
        } else {
          x--;
          error += 2 * (y - x) + 1;
        }
      }
    }

    function applyTool(target, from, to, value) {
      switch (state.tool) {
        case 'pencil':
        case 'eraser':
          drawLine(target, from.x, from.y, to.x, to.y, value);
          break;
        case 'line':
          drawLine(target, from.x, from.y, to.x, to.y, value);
          break;
        case 'rect':
          drawRect(target, from.x, from.y, to.x, to.y, value, false);
          break;
        case 'rectfill':
          drawRect(target, from.x, from.y, to.x, to.y, value, true);
          break;
        case 'circle':
        case 'circlefill': {
          const radius = Math.round(Math.hypot(to.x - from.x, to.y - from.y));
          drawCircle(target, from.x, from.y, radius, value, state.tool === 'circlefill');
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    const isFreehand = () => state.tool === 'pencil' || state.tool === 'eraser';

    // ── History ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    function pushUndo() {
      state.undo.push(state.pixels.slice());
      if (state.undo.length > 60) state.undo.shift();
      state.redo = [];
      updateHistoryButtons();
    }

    function updateHistoryButtons() {
      document.getElementById('undo').disabled = state.undo.length === 0;
      document.getElementById('redo').disabled = state.redo.length === 0;
    }

    // ── Mouse ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    function pointOf(event) {
      const rect = editor.getBoundingClientRect();
      const scale = editor.width / rect.width;
      return {
        x: Math.floor((event.clientX - rect.left) * scale / state.zoom),
        y: Math.floor((event.clientY - rect.top) * scale / state.zoom),
      };
    }

    editor.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    editor.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      editor.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      pushUndo();
      state.drawing = true;
      state.erasing = event.button === 2 || state.tool === 'eraser';
      state.start = pointOf(event);

      if (isFreehand()) {
        applyTool(state.pixels, state.start, state.start, state.erasing ? 0 : 1);
        redraw();
      }
    });

    editor.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
      if (!state.drawing) return;
      const point = pointOf(event);
      const value = state.erasing ? 0 : 1;

      if (isFreehand()) {
        applyTool(state.pixels, state.start, point, value);
        state.start = point;
        redraw();
      } else {
        const overlay = state.pixels.slice();
        applyTool(overlay, state.start, point, value);
        redraw(overlay);
      }
    });

    editor.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => {
      if (!state.drawing) return;
      const point = pointOf(event);
      if (!isFreehand()) {
        applyTool(state.pixels, state.start, point, state.erasing ? 0 : 1);
      }
      state.drawing = false;
      state.start = null;
      redraw();
    });

    editor.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
      state.drawing = false;
      state.start = null;
      redraw();
    });

    // ── Encoding, matched byte for byte by SSD1315.py ───────────────────────

    const B64 = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';

    function toBase64(bytes) {
      let out = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 3) {
        const a = bytes[i];
        const b = i + 1 < bytes.length ? bytes[i + 1] : 0;
        const c = i + 2 < bytes.length ? bytes[i + 2] : 0;
        out += B64[a >> 2];
        out += B64[((a & 3) << 4) | (b >> 4)];
        out += i + 1 < bytes.length ? B64[((b & 15) << 2) | (c >> 6)] : '=';
        out += i + 2 < bytes.length ? B64[c & 63] : '=';
      }
      return out;
    }

    function fromBase64(text) {
      const out = [];
      let accumulator = 0;
      let bits = 0;
      for (const char of text) {
        if (char === '=') break;
        const index = B64.indexOf(char);
        if (index < 0) continue;
        accumulator = (accumulator << 6) | index;
        bits += 6;
        if (bits >= 8) {
          bits -= 8;
          out.push((accumulator >> bits) & 0xFF);
        }
      }
      return Uint8Array.from(out);
    }

    /** One byte per eight vertical pixels, which is what the SSD1315 wants. */
    function pack(pixels, width, height) {
      const pages = height / 8;
      const packed = new Uint8Array(width * pages);
      for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
          if (pixels[y * width + x]) {
            packed[(y >> 3) * width + x] |= 1 << (y & 7);
          }
        }
      }
      return packed;
    }

    function unpack(packed, width, height) {
      const pixels = new Uint8Array(width * height);
      for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
          const byte = packed[(y >> 3) * width + x] || 0;
          pixels[y * width + x] = (byte >> (y & 7)) & 1;
        }
      }
      return pixels;
    }

    function runLength(bytes) {
      const out = [];
      let i = 0;
      while (i < bytes.length) {
        const value = bytes[i];
        let run = 1;
        while (i + run < bytes.length && bytes[i + run] === value && run < 255) run++;
        out.push(run, value);
        i += run;
      }
      return Uint8Array.from(out);
    }

    function encode(pixels, width, height) {
      const packed = pack(pixels, width, height);
      const rle = runLength(packed);
      // Whichever is smaller wins; a mostly blank sketch shrinks enormously,
      // a noisy one would grow, so raw stays available.
      const useRle = rle.length < packed.length;
      const body = useRle ? rle : packed;
      const payload = new Uint8Array(body.length + 1);
      payload[0] = useRle ? 1 : 0;
      payload.set(body, 1);
      return `XRPI1:${width}:${height}:${toBase64(payload)}`;
    }

    function decode(text) {
      const trimmed = String(text).trim();
      if (!trimmed.startsWith('XRPI1:')) {
        throw new Error('That does not look like a picture string (it should start with XRPI1:).');
      }
      const parts = trimmed.split(':');
      if (parts.length < 4) throw new Error('The picture text is incomplete.');

      const width = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
      const height = parseInt(parts[2], 10);
      if (!width || !height || height % 8) {
        throw new Error('The size in the text is not usable.');
      }

      const raw = fromBase64(parts[3]);
      if (!raw.length) throw new Error('There is no picture in that text.');

      let body;
      if (raw[0] === 0) {
        body = raw.slice(1);
      } else {
        const out = [];
        for (let i = 1; i + 1 < raw.length; i += 2) {
          for (let n = 0; n < raw[i]; n++) out.push(raw[i + 1]);
        }
        body = Uint8Array.from(out);
      }

      const needed = width * (height / 8);
      if (body.length < needed) {
        throw new Error(`The picture is short: ${body.length} bytes for a ${width}x${height} that needs ${needed}.`);
      }
      return { width, height, pixels: unpack(body, width, height) };
    }
```
